name: ai-exam-management-system
description: Full-stack AI-powered Student & Teacher Exam Management Platform with MERN and TypeScript

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend-teacher && npm install && cd ../frontend-student && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,TEACHER,STUDENT" -c "blue,magenta,cyan" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:teacher" "npm run dev:student"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:teacher && npm run build:student
